high_level_description: This image is a black-and-white newspaper front page from The New York Times dated Tuesday, May 5, 1970. The headline reads "4 Kent State Students Killed by Troops," which is the central focus of the page. Below the headline, there is a photograph depicting a chaotic scene. In the foreground, a person is lying on the ground, seemingly injured or dead, with their arms outstretched. A woman is kneeling beside them, appearing distressed, with her hands covering her face. Behind them, several individuals are standing, some looking on with expressions of shock or concern.
